description:
Куда движется стоимость новеллы. Стоимость новеллы, сцены и 1000 токенов по когортам даты старта новеллы, со скользящим сглаживанием вместо ям и пиков. Новеллы разной длины сравниваются через стоимость сцены и стоимость 1000 токенов. Всё можно смотреть по всем вариантам промптов сразу и отдельно по каждому (prompt_variant).

Дата новеллы — дата её первого LLM-вызова; стоимость новеллы — все её вызовы за всё время. Поэтому новеллы, начатые в периоде, учитываются целиком, а последние дни могут быть занижены (генерация ещё идёт).

prompt_variant не приходит в событиях llm.usage: справочник analytics.novel_prompt_variants наполняется из Postgres генератора командой `make sync-variants`, без записи в справочнике новелла показывается как unknown.

panels.description: Средняя стоимость одной новеллы за период: все LLM-вызовы новеллы (создание, настройка, все сцены и догенерации) / число новелл. Сглаживание здесь не применяется — это фактическое среднее за период.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
per_novel AS (
    SELECT
        c.entity_id AS entity_id,
        toStartOfDay(min(c.ts)) AS started,
        coalesce(nullIf(any(v.prompt_variant), ''), 'unknown') AS variant,
        sum(c.cost_${currency}) AS cost,
        sum(c.cost_input_usd * c.cost_${currency} / greatest(c.cost_usd, 1e-12)) AS cost_input,
        sum(c.cost_cached_usd * c.cost_${currency} / greatest(c.cost_usd, 1e-12)) AS cost_cached,
        sum(c.cost_output_usd * c.cost_${currency} / greatest(c.cost_usd, 1e-12)) AS cost_output,
        sum(c.prompt_tokens + c.completion_tokens) AS tokens,
        sum(c.prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens,
        sum(c.cached_tokens) AS cached_tokens,
        uniqExactIf(c.operation, c.scene_order > 0) AS scenes,
        count() AS calls
    FROM analytics.llm_calls_cost AS c
    LEFT JOIN analytics.novel_prompt_variants_v AS v ON c.entity_id = v.novel_id
    WHERE c.entity_id != ''
    GROUP BY c.entity_id
)
SELECT round(avg(cost), 4) AS value
FROM per_novel
WHERE $__timeFilter(started)
    AND variant IN (${prompt_variant:sqlstring})

panels.title: Сцен в периоде

panels.description: На сколько процентов изменилась сглаженная стоимость новеллы между началом и концом выбранного периода. Красный — стоимость растёт, зелёный — падает.

    SELECT

        sum(c.cached_tokens) AS cached_tokens,
        uniqExactIf(c.operation, c.scene_order > 0) AS scenes,
        count() AS calls
    FROM analytics.llm_calls_cost AS c
    LEFT JOIN analytics.novel_prompt_variants_v AS v ON c.entity_id = v.novel_id
    WHERE c.entity_id != ''
    GROUP BY c.entity_id
),
cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        started AS time,
        sum(cost) AS cost,
        sum(cost_input) AS cost_input,
        sum(cost_cached) AS cost_cached,
        sum(cost_output) AS cost_output,
        sum(tokens) AS tokens,
        sum(scenes) AS scenes_total,
        count() AS novels
    FROM per_novel
    WHERE variant IN (${prompt_variant:sqlstring})
    GROUP BY started
),
windowed AS (
    SELECT
        time,
        sum(cost) OVER w / greatest(sum(novels) OVER w, 1) AS value
    FROM cohorts
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
    WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN ${smoothing} PRECEDING AND ${smoothing} FOLLOWING)
)
SELECT round(
    (argMax(value, time) - argMin(value, time))
    / greatest(argMin(value, time), 1e-9) * 100,
    1
) AS value
FROM windowed

panels.title: Стоимость новеллы — тренд, ${currency:text}

panels.description: Стоимость одной сцены в скользящем окне: все затраты / все сцены новелл окна. Позволяет сравнивать новеллы с разным числом сцен: если растёт стоимость новеллы, но не сцены — новеллы просто стали длиннее.

panels.title: Цена 1000 токенов — тренд, ${currency:text}

        sum(c.cost_${currency}) AS cost,
        sum(c.cost_input_usd * c.cost_${currency} / greatest(c.cost_usd, 1e-12)) AS cost_input,
        sum(c.cost_cached_usd * c.cost_${currency} / greatest(c.cost_usd, 1e-12)) AS cost_cached,
        sum(c.cost_output_usd * c.cost_${currency} / greatest(c.cost_usd, 1e-12)) AS cost_output,
        sum(c.prompt_tokens + c.completion_tokens) AS tokens,
        sum(c.prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens,
        sum(c.cached_tokens) AS cached_tokens,
        uniqExactIf(c.operation, c.scene_order > 0) AS scenes,
        count() AS calls
    FROM analytics.llm_calls_cost AS c
    LEFT JOIN analytics.novel_prompt_variants_v AS v ON c.entity_id = v.novel_id
    WHERE c.entity_id != ''
    GROUP BY c.entity_id
),
cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        started AS time,
        variant AS variant,
        sum(cost) AS cost,
        sum(scenes) AS scenes_total,
        count() AS novels
    FROM per_novel
    WHERE variant IN (${prompt_variant:sqlstring})
    GROUP BY started, variant
)
SELECT
    time,
    variant,
    round(sum(cost) OVER w / greatest(sum(novels) OVER w, 1), 6) AS "Стоимость новеллы"
FROM cohorts
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY variant ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN ${smoothing} PRECEDING AND ${smoothing} FOLLOWING)
ORDER BY time, variant

panels.description: Итоги за период по вариантам промптов: число новелл и сцен, стоимость новеллы (среднее и медиана), цена сцены и 1000 токенов, попадание в кэш и доля в общих затратах. `unknown` — новеллы без записи в справочнике вариантов.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
per_novel AS (
    SELECT
        c.entity_id AS entity_id,
        toStartOfDay(min(c.ts)) AS started,
        coalesce(nullIf(any(v.prompt_variant), ''), 'unknown') AS variant,
        sum(c.cost_${currency}) AS cost,
        sum(c.cost_input_usd * c.cost_${currency} / greatest(c.cost_usd, 1e-12)) AS cost_input,
        sum(c.cost_cached_usd * c.cost_${currency} / greatest(c.cost_usd, 1e-12)) AS cost_cached,
        sum(c.cost_output_usd * c.cost_${currency} / greatest(c.cost_usd, 1e-12)) AS cost_output,
        sum(c.prompt_tokens + c.completion_tokens) AS tokens,
        sum(c.prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens,
        sum(c.cached_tokens) AS cached_tokens,
        uniqExactIf(c.operation, c.scene_order > 0) AS scenes,
        count() AS calls
    FROM analytics.llm_calls_cost AS c
    LEFT JOIN analytics.novel_prompt_variants_v AS v ON c.entity_id = v.novel_id
    WHERE c.entity_id != ''
    GROUP BY c.entity_id
),
by_variant AS (
    SELECT
        variant,
        count() AS novels,
        sum(scenes) AS scenes_total,
        sum(cost) AS cost_total,
        sum(tokens) AS tokens_total,
        sum(cached_tokens) AS cached_tokens_total,
        sum(prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens_total,
        avgIf(cost, scenes > 0) AS avg_cost,
        avgIf(cost / greatest(scenes, 1), scenes > 0) AS avg_cost_per_scene,
        quantile(0.5)(cost) AS median_cost
    FROM per_novel
    WHERE $__timeFilter(started)
        AND variant IN (${prompt_variant:sqlstring})
    GROUP BY variant
)
SELECT
    variant AS "Вариант",
    novels AS "Новелл",
    scenes_total AS "Сцен",
    round(avg_cost, 4) AS "Новелла, ${currency:text}",
    round(median_cost, 4) AS "Медиана, ${currency:text}",
    round(avg_cost_per_scene, 5) AS "Сцена, ${currency:text}",
    round(cost_total / greatest(tokens_total, 1) * 1000, 5) AS "1000 ток., ${currency:text}",
    round(cached_tokens_total / greatest(prompt_tokens_total, 1) * 100, 1) AS "Кэш, %",
    round(cost_total / greatest(sum(cost_total) OVER (), 1) * 100, 1) AS "Доля, %"
FROM by_variant
ORDER BY cost_total DESC

)
SELECT

    variant AS "Вариант",
    formatDateTime(started, '%Y-%m-%d') AS "Старт",
    scenes AS "Сцен",
    calls AS "Вызовов",
    tokens AS "Токенов",
    round(cost, 4) AS "Стоимость, ${currency:text}",
    round(cost / greatest(scenes, 1), 5) AS "Сцена, ${currency:text}",
    round(cost / greatest(tokens, 1) * 1000, 5) AS "1000 токенов, ${currency:text}",
    round(cached_tokens / greatest(prompt_tokens, 1) * 100, 1) AS "Кэш, %"
FROM per_novel
WHERE $__timeFilter(started)
    AND variant IN (${prompt_variant:sqlstring})
ORDER BY started DESC, cost DESC
LIMIT 500
